allOf.description: The Invaract run this OpenLineage run publishes: how Invaract was attached, and, on the run's terminal event, its totals.

mode.description: enforce: writes that break their contract are refused; dryRun: nothing is enforced.

invaractRunId.description: The engine's own id for the run (Spark's application id, the Python run's id).

jobId.description: The job's stable id across runs (the jobId setting).

attributes.description: What the platform attached to the run (the jobAttributes setting).

checksPassed.description: On the terminal event: the writes checked that kept to their contract.

checksFailed.description: On the terminal event: the writes refused.

violations.description: On the terminal event: the violations found.

writes.description: On the terminal event: the writes the engine reported completed.
